component.name: KholaBangla Keyboard
component.summary: An OpenSource, Unicode compliant Bengali Input Method

description.p: KholaBangla Keyboard is an OpenSource, Unicode compliant Bengali Input Method for GNU/Linux systems. It's a full fledged Bengali input method with typing automation tools, includes many famous typing methods such as Avro Phonetic, Probhat, Munir Optima, National (Jatiya) etc.
Most of the features of Avro Keyboard are present in KholaBangla Keyboard. So Avro Keyboard users will feel at home with KholaBangla Keyboard in Linux.
